video_title: Carter Bryant PAID for Gilbert Arenas' Sins at Arizona

quotes.speaker: Carter Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Carter Bryant warned not to contact Gilbert Arenas at Arizona
quotes.excerpt: don't contact Gilbert Arenas. Whatever you do, don't contact him.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Have you ever tapped into some of the alumni that have ever gone through there, whether that's Jason Terry or Richard Jefferson or Steve Kerr?

text_blocks.speaker: Carter Bryant
text_blocks.text: The first initial thing that anybody that has attended Arizona told me about our alumni is just don't contact Gilbert Arenas. Whatever you do, don't contact him. He's a bad person. I'm playing, but they were just like, no, he's going to, he's a bad guy. No, I'm playing.

quotes.speaker: Carter Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Carter Bryant on Gilbert Arenas' reputation at Arizona
quotes.excerpt: I've heard so many stories about Gilbert and it's crazy because there's some professors that were there.
quotes.quote: I've heard so many stories about Gilbert and it's crazy because there's some professors that were there while I had their classes and they're like, I'm not going to air out his business, but I'm not going to air out his business.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins recounts Gilbert Arenas' freshman symposium incident
quotes.excerpt: He walked with me. He had a Kuji headband of a white beater and a gigantic GJA chain.
quotes.quote: He walked with me. He had a Kuji headband of a white beater and a gigantic GJA chain that might have been worth 100,000 and Kuji pants, a shorts and then some Tims, walked in with me. I had to sit first five rows because Ross was like, hey, Freshy, you got some first five rows. Gilbert sits there for about two minutes, but the guy is trying to go through the the syllabus and Gilbert's like making noises. He goes, hey man, this is boring. Let's get up, Channing. And I'm like, first day of school.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Gilbert Arenas disrupting class
quotes.excerpt: Hey man, F this class. And they make the noise, yeah. And then the teacher just looking at me.
quotes.quote: Walks up, it's a huge, you know, like the regular general 200 something people, walks up and you know the lights, right? Like these lights are LED. You know they shut down and warm back up, correct? Hey man, F this class. And they make the noise, yeah. And then the teacher just looking at me, I go, I don't know that dude. And Gilbert wonders why he went in the second round.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Gilbert Arenas as a student
quotes.excerpt: They're like he was the worst possible human being you could ever have.
quotes.quote: They didn't have to ask very much about Gilbert. They're like, hey, Gilbert Arenas, tell us about him as a student. They're like he was the worst possible human being you could ever have. Great, great basketball player, actually a fairly good teammate.

quotes.speaker: Carter Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Carter Bryant on his freshman class experience
quotes.excerpt: Teacher's like, you gotta be basketball players. I had Gilbert Arenas, we're not doing any of that.
quotes.quote: I had a class, some literature or art of some regard, essentially. But I walked in and it was me and another freshman, I think it was Emmanuel Stephens that went to Arizona. We walk in the class and they're like, teacher's like, you gotta be basketball players. I had Gilbert Arenas, we're not doing any of that. I'm like, you haven't even asked me my name yet. Like I'm just wearing an Arizona basketball shirt, so you already came at me. I was like, okay, let me just A+ behavior.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Gilbert Arenas' DVD player antics
quotes.excerpt: He would watch movies with headphones on during the test and just hand his test to somebody.
quotes.quote: He would bring his backpack. You know what a DVD player is? Yes, I know what a DVD player is. I'm just asking. He would watch movies with headphones on during the test and just hand his test to somebody like this and wants a DVD and they did the test. He was like, yeah, they go.

quotes.speaker: Carter Bryant

quotes.quote: Keldon. Because he too country. He too country. He got a whole compound. He like, he real country boy. Like he goes hunting, he does all that stuff.

quotes.speaker: Carter Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Carter Bryant on Keldon Johnson's hog hunting
quotes.excerpt: He talks about going on a chopper and like going hog hunting on the chopper.
quotes.quote: Like when you know Keldon, like he talks about going on a chopper and like going hog hunting on the chopper. I'm like, Keldon, just please don't hurt me. Please.
